Estantería is a shelving unit that can hold books or other objects. Librero names a bookcase in Mexico and several other Latin American countries; it can also mean a bookseller, depending on context. Biblioteca usually refers to a library or book collection, but it can also mean bookcase. Grouped alternatives avoid competing equivalent answers in quizzes. Example: Los libros están en la estantería. Sources: RAE/ASALE entries estantería, librero and biblioteca.

A shelf that supports books or other objects. Estante can also refer to an entire shelving unit, so the distinction from estantería is not absolute. Plural: los estantes. Example: El libro está en el estante de arriba. Source: RAE/ASALE entry estante.
